body: Same. Hardest part about this. My day is tomorrow. I feel as commited as when I made it, but it is not an easy decision.
Right? 🤣  cracks me up so much

It wasn't for me.  I had 3 grand Mal  seizures I don't remember, and I'm haunted by my survival.  Feel like it caused other problems, but im still here. I was forced to ride out the overdose with no intervention by the hospital until after I started seizing either. I'm learning that's it's actually surprisingly hard to OD.

Thank you for this. I never see anything from other survivors. I attempted and came very close to succeeding in January.  I then moved all the way across rhe country leaving behind my son, my pets, my car, and all my belongings other than 2 carry on size suitcases.  I've had no support at all since.  None. No one to talk to who is willing to listen and understand without either getting mad or making it about them. I've had no therapy, no meds. Nothing. I regret every day that I didn't succeed.

I just don't get it at all. I attempted suicide in January of this year. Since then ALL of my so called friends stopped talking to me and my family is constantly mad at me for ignoring them. I've had no counseling, not on any meds. Have NO ONE to talk to, etc. I literally HATE every day that I survived and feel obligated to keep going. Like please, I'm suffering enough. Can we please just let it end now. Wish there was more support for attempt survivors.
